verdict.rationale: The pack shows that API reference pages exist (e.g. the create-card endpoint page), but nothing shows they are interactive or offer runnable 'try it' examples. The closest evidence is the MCP server, which lets an AI assistant inspect schemas and run live API calls from an editor. That is a separate capability from an interactive API reference, so it earns no credit here. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
